title: FM3 sound specification 0.8.11 (two-row layout or general grid)

insert.description: Point-6 blocks inserted from the device-default donor; all 8 scenes start on channel A, bypassed. Mixer and Multiplexer only in grid mode; Scene MIDI (grid mode only) is placed unconnected; Volume/Pan uses volumePan. Multi Delay uses Quad-Tap Delay defaults; Algorithm and supported parameters are writable through controls; Type/preset selection remains blocked.

recordOrder.description: 0.3.58: where an inserted block's record goes in the preset. device (default): where the FM3 itself stores it when device exports fix that position (references/fm3-record-order-20261107.json, T38), else last. append: always last (the behaviour before 0.3.58; for packs built earlier). 0.3.70: also in grid mode with insert or duplicate; there the default stays append (every grid pack built before 0.3.70), and device places each added record by the same evidence (kept records keep their order, Out 2 follows Out 1). Grid-mode device order is by evidence and not yet confirmed by a stored dump (T51).

volumePan.description: Insert captured FW13 Volume/Pan 1 VOLUME record; include volpan in the existing two-row layout.

grid.description: General 4 x 12 grid (fm3-grid.mjs). Every block in the preset must be placed; every cell must lie on an In 1/Return/Synth -> Out 1/Send path. Default input: same row, previous column.

remove.description: Grid mode only. Records removed before the grid is written; In 1, Out 1, Amp, Cab stay; Send and Return together.

duplicate.description: Grid mode only. Second/later instances seen in FW10 factory presets; copy of the previous instance with its own effect ID, all 8 scenes A/bypass. "out2": Out 1 record with effect ID 43 directly after Out 1 (place out2 as a sink, usually under Out 1).

volumePedal.description: External 1 (or volumePedal.source) -> Volume/Pan 1 Volume (VOLUME_GAIN), channels ALL, FW13 captured defaults. true = Min 0 / Max 10; {min,max} sets modifier words 1/2 with the VOLUME_GAIN codec (T10); curve sets the curve and timing words 3-7 and 13-15 with the native-descriptor codec (T12; fm3-modifier-curve.mjs). Record 0, or record 1 when composer.modifiers.external1Wah is true. Requires volumePan:true.

curve.description: Modify-page curve and timing fields; omitted fields keep the captured defaults (Start 0, Mid 50, End 100, Slope 50, Attack 10.1 ms, Scale 1, Offset 0, Release 10.1 ms).

source.description: 0.3.55: modifier Source (word 0 = FM3-Edit MOD_CTRLID index); default External 1. Device-confirmed: LFO 1A (T33, 2026-11-06), Scene Controller 1, Sequencer, ADSR 1 (T34, 2026-11-07); other Controllers sources from the editor list, not tested. Set the source itself with controllers / controllersScenes.

sceneMidi.description: Grid mode only, needs insert ["scenemidi"]. Scene MIDI commands decoded on FM3 fw 13 (2026-10-24): type PC/CC/NONE, MIDI channel 1..16; PC takes program 0..127 (the FM3 Value field; Number shows --); CC takes number 0..127 and value 0..127.

controlSwitches.description: Control Switch 1..6 -> Amp switch bindings with the FM3 default template, consecutive records from 1 (2 next to Wah + Volume). Each target once.

controlSwitchScenes.description: Control Switch state per scene (FC PER-PRESET -> CS Per Scene, stored in the preset). Each listed Control Switch needs a controlSwitches binding; unlisted states stay OFF. T14b device-confirmed codes.

footswitches.description: Per-preset footswitches (Per-Preset FC definitions PP#1.. in list order + Overrides, stored in the preset). Override position = 12 x (layout - 1) + (switch - 1) (T15/T16). Each entry is a Control Switch (needs a controlSwitches binding), an Effect Bypass of a mapped block (instance 1 of 27 families + resonator2; drive1/delay1 (T45) and compressor1/chorus1/tremolo1/pitch1/flanger1/synth1/rotary1/reverb1 (T47) switch-confirmed 2026-11-12; the other 17 first instances switch-confirmed T48 2026-11-13; resonator2 mapped from the FM3-Edit display T46 only, switch untested; the block must be in the preset) or a Scene Select (T44/T45).

controllers.description: Controllers block (LFO 1/2, ADSR 1/2, Envelope, Sequencer, Scene Controllers, Manual): 0.3.50, T28. Status gate and refusals (Tempo, Tempo To Use, X/Y marks) are generator rules.

controllersScenes.description: 0.3.55 (T33): Controllers channel of scenes 1..n, scene 1 first (body 462+2*(scene-1), 0..3 = A..D); unlisted scenes stay A. T33 confirmed scenes 1..4 = A..D and T34 scenes 5..8 = D,C,B,D on the device.

multidelayTypes.description: 0.3.56 (T35): Multi Delay Type per channel as a full-channel template: all 121 words become the image the FM3 produced after choosing that Type on the device-default channel (T35 2026-11-07, 39/39 measured). Needs a Multi Delay block (insert or grid). Controls apply afterwards; the Type's Algorithm stays. T36 (2026-11-07) loaded such a preset on the FM3: 484/484 words held, FM3-Edit showed the Types, audio as described; T38 (2026-11-07) STOREd and reloaded another four Types with all channel data unchanged.

modifierEdits.description: Edit only bindings authored by this sound spec, identified by record and expected source/target. No arbitrary preset or free-slot allocation. Scene/footswitch bindings must remain valid in the final state.

modifierTargets.description: 0.3.60 (T42): Source -> block parameter modifier bindings with the FM3 default template, next unused records after volumePedal / controlSwitches. Targets: parameters whose FM3-Edit FW13 flag 0x0080 is clear (468 labelled; fm3-preset.mjs --capabilities). Device-confirmed: Delay Mix, Filter Freq, Amp Gain (T42, STORE byte-identical); the FM3 cleared a bit-set target (Delay Low Cut). Target rule, Min/Max representability and block presence are generator rules. 0.3.69: optional curve / timing per binding.

min.description: display value; continuous targets only (default: full range)

max.description: display value; continuous targets only (default: full range)

curve.description: 0.3.69: Modify-page curve and timing fields of this binding (record words 3-7, 13-15); omitted fields keep the template defaults (Start 0, Mid 50, End 100, Slope 50, Attack 10.1 ms, Scale 1, Offset 0, Release 10.1 ms). The codec was stepped on the device on the Volume record (T12); T50 (2026-11-13) confirmed written curves on FILTER_FREQ, DISTORT_LEVEL and DELAY_MIX; on other targets it is formula-derived.

tempo.description: 0.3.60 (T42): preset tempo in BPM, written to all four Controllers channels; Tempo To Use stays PRESET. T42 showed 97 and 143 BPM on the FM3, byte-identical after STORE/reload.
